name: Krishca Strapping Solutions Ltd.
summary: Krishca Strapping Solutions Ltd. is an India-based company specializing in the manufacturing and wholesale of comprehensive industrial packaging solutions. The company's primary products include high-tensile steel straps, offered in various grades such as Prime, Super Prime, Ultra Prime, and Mega Prime, along with strapping seals and strapping tools. Their steel strappings feature a wax coating and lubrication for smooth application in automated machinery, with surface finish options including Blue Tempered, Painted, and Zinc. Krishca Strapping Solutions also manufactures a range of seals, including snap-on, thread-on, nestack, open-flange, and push-type, and partners with manufacturers to provide diverse strapping tools and stretch wrapping machines. The company is noted for its eco-friendly, lead-free production line for heat-treated steel strapping and offers customization for branding on steel seals. Krishca Strapping Solutions primarily targets the industrial packaging and material handling markets within India, with some export operations to countries in the Middle East. Their clientele includes major steel producers like Jindal, JSW, POSCO, SAIL, BAOSTEEL, AJ Steel, THL pipe, Hyundai steel, St. Gobain, and Gold plus, as well as packaging contractors, providing packaging solutions for securing goods during storage and transit.
